description: Utility functions for filesystem operations, error parsing, permission management, and file size handling within the Notesnook mobile app.

methods.name: getRandomId
methods.description: Generates a random string ID with an optional prefix.

methods.name: parseS3Error
methods.description: Parses XML error response from S3 and extracts error code and message.

methods.name: cancelable
methods.description: Wraps an async operation to support cancellation.

methods.name: copyFileAsync
methods.description: Copies a file asynchronously using ScopedStorage.

methods.name: releasePermissions
methods.description: Releases persisted URI permissions on Android for a given path.

methods.name: getUploadedFileSize
methods.description: Fetches the size of an uploaded file from the server, with retries.

methods.name: checkUpload
methods.description: Verifies the uploaded file size matches expected size.

methods.name: checkAndCreateDir
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists and creates it if necessary.

methods.name: santizeUri
methods.description: Sanitizes a file URI for iOS.
